reason: Verified facts about the published @talex-touch/tuffex@0.5.0 package: exports, missing ./vite plugin, barrel shapes for auto-registration, the 39 internal icon classes, SSR hazards, and a props/slots/emits cheat-sheet for every component the forum uses.
Props/emits conventions, Loading States (skeleton via TxRowSkeleton + useDeferredLoading is mandatory for first-load views), accessibility expectations.
When to use Pinia vs local state; keep view state local, forum data in stores.
Forbidden patterns (no div/span @click when a native/TuffEx control exists; no SSR output depending on localStorage/time/random; mock evidence must not be reported as production completion).
scripts/check-styles.mjs must fail when the thing it protects breaks; design its --self-test accordingly.
